import type { OpenRefusal } from './open'

/** UI languages. Add a language by adding a table below; nothing else needs to change. */
export type Lang = 'en' | 'ja'

/** Every user-visible string. Entries that depend on a value are functions. */
export type Messages = {
  paneTitle: string
  /** Description of the slash command that opens the pane. */
  commandDescription: string
  commandReply: string

  tabProject: string
  tabAll: string
  /** The only non-backlog tab when the folder maps to no tags. */
  tabBoard: string
  tabBacklog: string

  usageHeading: string
  usageEmpty: string
  /** Labels of the known limit windows; unknown kinds are shown as their raw name. */
  limitFiveHour: string
  limitSevenDay: string
  usageUntil: (time: string) => string

  folderLabel: string
  lookHeading: (count: number) => string
  open: string
  done: string

  sectionInProgress: string
  sectionBlocked: string
  sectionReview: string
  sectionBacklog: string
  sectionEmpty: string
  reload: string
  readAt: (clock: string) => string
  boardUnreadable: (path: string) => string
  /** Shown when there is no board path to read (HOME is not set and no board path is configured). */
  boardNoPath: string

  bandWorking: string
  bandFinished: (duration: string, tools: number, isLong: boolean) => string
  bandCounts: (inProgress: number, review: number) => string
  bandBoardButton: string
  bandHideButton: string
  greetingMorning: string
  greetingDay: string
  greetingEvening: string
  greetingNight: string
  /** Duration of a turn, e.g. `42s` or `2m30s`. */
  duration: (seconds: number) => string

  pathCopied: (path: string) => string
  copyFailed: (reason: string) => string
  openFailed: (reason: string) => string
  /** Why a target was not opened (a refusal of the allowlist, see open.ts). */
  refusal: (reason: OpenRefusal) => string

  toolDescription: string
  toolTargetDescription: string
  toolTitleDescription: string
  toolNoteDescription: string
  toolEmptyTitle: string
  /** The target has control characters, a line break, or is too long; it is refused as it is, never rewritten. */
  toolTargetNotPlain: string
  /** Registering the command or the tool failed at session start; the pane and the timer still start. */
  setupFailed: (reason: string) => string
  toolBadTarget: (received: string) => string
  toolAdded: (title: string) => string
  toolAddedButFailed: (title: string, reason: string) => string
  toolEmptyReceived: string
  /** The target is a directory or another non-file. */
  toolNotFile: (received: string) => string
  /** Listed but not opened, because the allowlist does not cover it. */
  toolAddedNotOpened: (title: string, reason: string) => string
  /** Neither CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR nor HOME is set, so there is nowhere to keep the queue. */
  toolNoQueue: string
  toolQueueBroken: (path: string) => string
}

/** The message tables, keyed by language. */
export const MESSAGES: Record<Lang, Messages> = { en, ja }

/**
 * Chooses the UI language. An explicit setting wins when it names a supported language; otherwise the
 * first non-empty locale variable decides, in POSIX order (`LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, `LANG`): `ja_JP.UTF-8`
 * gives Japanese, and anything else gives English.
 */
export function resolveLang(explicitLang: string | undefined, ...systemLangs: Array<string | undefined>): Lang {
  const explicit = explicitLang?.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (explicit === 'en' || explicit === 'ja') return explicit
  const system = systemLangs.find(value => value !== undefined && value.trim() !== '')

  return system?.toLowerCase().startsWith('ja') ? 'ja' : 'en'
}

/** The message table for a language. */
export function messages(lang: Lang): Messages {
  return MESSAGES[lang]
}
